_readme: Public IPv4 literals that must stay in tracked files.
Checked by scripts/audit-real-ips.mjs. Every entry needs a reason.
Prefer an environment variable, or an RFC 5737 documentation address
Unused entries are reported, not fatal, so they can be deleted.

allow.reason: Cloudflare's public DNS resolver, in a `dig @1.1.1.1` command. A documentation-range address would make the command fail — the whole point is querying a resolver that answers.
Anthropic's published egress range, shown as a worked nginx allow example. A fake range would teach the wrong value. The page already says to use the live list rather than this snapshot.
Second half of the same published egress range — see the entry above.
